actions.action: Isolate the plant from other plants
Wash hands and tools after touching the plant
Dab every visible tuft with a cotton swab dipped in 70% rubbing alcohol
Check stems and leaf undersides daily for new tufts
Spray the whole plant with insecticidal soap every 5-7 days for 3-4 weeks
Rinse gotu kola well before eating and check label for harvest waiting period
Once no new tufts for two weeks, repot into clean pot with fresh potting mix after shaking off old soil, rinsing and inspecting roots
If tufts keep returning after four weeks, report back for other options

reason: The answer correctly identifies mealybugs and leads with 70% alcohol treatment, which matches the fix that worked, and the added insecticidal soap and delayed repotting are not harmful.
